key_insight: A curvilinear moving overset framework achieves stable, high-order, non-dissipative CFD on moving grids by enforcing only incoming characteristic information at single-layer interfaces.
engineering_relevance: This enables accurate and efficient simulation of complex unsteady aero flows with moving parts while reducing interface communication and avoiding artificial dissipation.
method: Up to sixth-order centered finite differences in the interior
Single-layer overset fringe with characteristic-based interface treatment
Viscous cases additionally impose viscous fluxes at the interface
evidence_signal: The abstract reports validation through eigenvalue analysis and multiple benchmark tests spanning 1-D advection, vortex convection, rotating cylinders, and pitching/oscillating airfoils and wings in both inviscid and viscous regimes.
watch_item: High-order stability depends on careful characteristic decomposition and moving-grid interface implementation, especially for viscous flows and complex 3D geometries.
paper_title: Curvilinear Moving Overset Method for High-order Non-dissipative Schemes
